tools.name: list_datasets
tools.description: Find public collections by title, instrument or ID, with sources and available Ocean tools.

tools.name: search_models
tools.description: Find models and their licenses, availability, benchmarks and trial links within a scientific task lane.

tools.name: get_pioneer_observations
tools.description: Read Gianna acquisitions and their matched sensor values with original UTC times, quality flags and missing values. Filter by a UTC date or page through the six-day replay.

tools.name: get_glonet_forecast
tools.description: Return ten dated daily forecasts and the matched GLO12 persistence baseline from an archived OceanBench run. Depth is in metres.

tools.name: get_pioneer_storm_scores
tools.description: Read the frozen six-hour salinity model's latest published verification, including paired hours, observations still missing and gain over persistence.

tools.name: estimate_chlorophyll
tools.description: Calculate NASA's R2022 OC3M band-ratio estimate from three remote-sensing reflectances in inverse steradians.

tools.name: classify_plankton
tools.description: Send one public example or one permitted PNG to SIG.AI's hosted shared 101-class classifier. It processes the image in memory and returns three provisional candidates. The call does not contribute the image for training.
